name: Into The Shadow Realm reduces the cooldown of Deathstalker, Soulstone Lure and Soul Shear
contract: Into The Shadow Realm 561342 is a passive SpellMod: its single effect (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) carries SpellFamilyFlags[2]=4 (bit2), which is shared verbatim by Deathstalker 804054, Soulstone Lure 561376 and Soul Shear 520862 (each has SpellFamilyFlags[2]=4), base points -26 (raw -25%). This is a native, generic SpellMod op requiring no CoA-specific code. Issue #2050 reported no handler exists for any of the three named spells; this proves the one shared classmask bit already reaches all three.

steps.label: Deathstalker cooldown unmodified before the talent
Soulstone Lure cooldown unmodified before the talent
Soul Shear cooldown unmodified before the talent
Into The Shadow Realm aura settles on the caster
Soulstone Lure cooldown is reduced by 25%
Soul Shear cooldown is reduced by 25%
